description.value:
Militech Wyvern: Smart; 14 Improved Smart rounds

Generic Smart weapon (standard quality): the type is built in, at no extra cost, and takes no slots.

Smart: Link: the gun only works while connected to you by a Personal Link (Neuroport) or Subdermal Grip. +1 to ranged Attacks with it, whatever it's loaded with. Improved Smart Ammunition works only in a Smart weapon, and adds two things: you ignore all penalties for darkness, smoke, fog and other visual obscurement; and when you miss by 5 or less you can try again at once, rolling 14 + 1d10 (LUCK still adds) instead of STAT + Skill + bonuses. The first shot's penalties carry over.
